covers: rlgl's blending as rlSetBlendMode sets GL's (every BLEND_ mode, BLEND_ALPHA's alpha by glBlendFunc's one pair of factors, the custom factors and when they take effect, a factor GL refuses) and rlColorMask, a render texture's alpha under them drawn over the screen; UpdateTexture and UpdateTextureRec (from bytes, a grayscale texture, a rectangle past the edge, in memory and on the GPU, ordered among render texture passes and the batch); render textures keeping what they hold, from pass to pass and frame to frame, and an update (from colors) between two draws in one; LoadImageFromTexture of a texture drawn and updated in the frame, and LoadImageFromScreen part way through the frame, a part of it drawn over the frame going on; DrawMeshInstanced, its shader's instanceTransform attribute; GenTextureMipmaps on the CPU, before and after a texture's first draw, and SetTextureFilter's mipmapped filters and anisotropy, drawn into a 640 x 480 frame
notes: SDL_GPU's frame (Vulkan on lavapipe) differs from Mesa's GL by one level in about 12,600 blended pixels, its blending rounding apart (1,000 of them in the screen read's copy of the first two blend cells, which matches the cells it was cut from exactly), and in about 830 of the mipmapped squares, lavapipe choosing levels a little apart from llvmpipe; GL's matches raylib's exactly, the mipmaps made on the CPU too.
